summary.text: Rob Matzie, listed by Ballotpedia as Robert Matzie, is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 16, having taken office on December 1, 2008, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chaired the Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure Committee in the 2023-2024 session and is a former mayor of Ambridge.

paragraphs.text: Matzie earned an A.A. in High Technology Communications from the Community College of Beaver County and a B.A. in journalism and communications from Point Park University.
His professional experience includes working as a radio show host for WMBA Radio and as a field office representative for state Senator Gerald J. LaValle.
He served as a Beaver County representative on the Pennsylvania Democratic State Committee and was mayor of Ambridge from 2003 to 2004.
Matzie has been a state representative since December 1, 2008.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
